name: octto-portable
description: Host-neutral browser brainstorming service over MCP

scripts.build: bun build src/portable/cli.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm
scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run check && bun run build
scripts.check: biome check . && eslint . && bun run typecheck && bun test tests
scripts.test:e2e: docker build -f e2e/Dockerfile -t octto-e2e . && docker run --rm octto-e2e

author: vtemian and contributors
